prompts.text: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic fantasy photo. A luxurious dark bathroom with polished black marble walls, subtle white marble veins, and a large rectangular mirror surrounded by warm golden LED lighting. The atmosphere is mysterious, elegant, and cinematic, with deep shadows, realistic golden reflections, and a calm, silent mood. The person from the uploaded image stands directly in front of the mirror with their back facing the camera, in elegant black clothes (a sleeveless black dress for a woman, a fitted black shirt for a man), the other hand resting on the black marble counter. The camera shoots from behind the person's shoulder, clearly showing the person's silhouette, their own hair from the photo and the mirror. The person raises one hand and gently presses their open palm flat against the glass, and turns the head a little over the shoulder toward the camera, so the face shows clearly in three-quarter view. Inside the mirror, the person's reflection is a magnificent, realistic black panther that stands in the exact position of the person's reflection, upright and close to the glass, filling one side of the mirror. Its glossy black fur catches the warm golden light, while its glowing amber eyes stare intensely at the person. The black panther raises one front paw and presses its soft black paw pad against the mirror, perfectly aligning with the person's palm on the opposite side of the glass. The hand and paw remain connected through the transparent mirror surface. Only the reflection transforms. The real person outside the mirror remains completely human and physically unchanged. Across the top of the mirror glass, in elegant warm cream serif letters on two centered lines, the text reads exactly: "Si tú eres la que resuelve," and "¿a qué le tienes miedo?". If the person in the photo is a man, it reads exactly "Si tú eres el que resuelve," and "¿a qué le tienes miedo?". Spell every word and accent exactly. No other text anywhere. Realistic mirror geometry, physically accurate feline anatomy, dramatic golden rim lighting, deep cinematic shadows, realistic black fur, subtle reflections, premium photographic quality. Vertical 9:16, the whole mirror and the person from the hips up in frame. Strict constraints: no transformation of the real subject, no panther outside the mirror, no broken glass, no mirror portal effect, no additional characters, no human-panther hybrid, no duplicated limbs, no extra hands, no distorted paws, no cartoon appearance, no watermark, no logos. Exactly one person and one panther. The identity rules below apply to the person outside the mirror: the face seen over the shoulder, the hair, the skin tone and the body.
